summary.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 62.3% YoY to INR296.6 crore and EBITDA 79.7% to INR51.4 crore, while PAT grew 37.9% to INR28.2 crore.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was INR296.6 crore (up 62.3% YoY), EBITDA INR51.4 crore (up 79.7%) and PAT INR28.2 crore (up 37.9%). PBT grew more slowly (41.4%) because interest income fell after surplus fixed deposits were deployed into GScale Energy and GL Hakko stakes. H1 FY27 revenue was INR544.3 crore (up 53%) and operating cash flow was INR61 crore, above the INR45 crore for all of FY26. GScale is still pre-operational, with revenue targeted from December 2026 and FY27 guidance of over INR250 crore from GScale alongside about 50% core growth, for a total of INR1,450 crore.

financial_highlights.change: Exceeds INR45 crore generated in full FY26

segments.name: Core engineering (SETL)
segments.commentary: Management says core business grew about 50% in FY27 guidance; order book stated at almost INR1,000 crore, with H1 inflow about INR600 crore and a further INR600 crore targeted in H2. Core EBITDA margin is 17.3%. Exports are 7-8% of revenue this year.

segments.name: GScale Energy (data center infrastructure)
segments.commentary: Pre-operational. Secondary fluid network (SFN) revenue targeted from 15 December 2026, power products production from 15 January 2027. Target over INR250 crore revenue in Q4 FY27. Long-term EBITDA margin target 20-25%. Stake: 34% acquired for about INR125 crore cash, with a further 17.45% via INR64 crore share swap pending exchange approval, taking the holding to 51%.

segments.name: GL Hakko (Japan)
segments.commentary: 19.19% stake acquired as first phase of investment, supporting glass-lining technology, R&D and engineering capabilities. Export-focused.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue guidance of INR1,450 crore: about 50% growth in core business plus over INR250 crore from GScale.
GScale revenue of over INR250 crore targeted in Q4 FY27, subject to timely production readiness and execution.
Factory go-live slipped about 15 days from end-November to around 15 December 2026.
Exports targeted at 20-30% of consolidated revenue in 2-3 years; FY27 exports about 7-8%.
Management expects QoQ absolute PAT to rise from Q3 FY27 as interest income effect stabilises; FY28 and FY29 guidance to come later.
GScale EBITDA target 20-25%; core business to rise from 17.3% to about 20% over coming years.
Installed capacity after adding 3-4 lakh sq ft: core production capacity of about INR3,500-4,000 crore (management's figure); no timeline given.
risks_watch: GScale go-live timing: factory now targeted 15 December 2026; SFN revenue depends on it, and any further slippage pushes the INR250 crore Q4 target.
No named or signed GScale orders disclosed; MNC tender results pending and described as large and slow to close.
Revenue concentration in the new GScale business, which has no operating history; customer approvals depend on factory visits and hyperscaler qualification.
Pending exchange approval for the 17.45% share swap needed to reach 51% of GScale.
Interest income loss from deployed funds will continue until GScale and GL Hakko contribute; PBT growth trails EBITDA growth.
Management declined to give capex per MW or peak revenue from the current 4 lakh sq ft facility, and deferred FY28 guidance.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, data center opportunity and order visibility, but evasive on specifics: order names, peak revenue, capex per MW and FY28 guidance were all deferred. Timelines have already slipped by about 15 days.
key_quotes: Our core business is growing strongly. Our capabilities are expanding, and we are seeing excellent opportunities in India and international markets.
For FY27, we have already guided almost 50% growth from the core business and another INR250 crores business coming from GScale.
Currently, the core business is at 17.3%, and it will increase slightly.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst asked whether the company plans to raise its stake in GScale, given the INR125 crore for 34%.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the INR64 crore share swap for a further 17.45% (taking the holding to 51%) is awaiting stock exchange approval; shareholders have approved it.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst asked for FY27 consolidated revenue growth from GScale, the Japan subsidiary and the group, plus 2-3 year guidance.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said FY27 guidance is almost 50% growth in the core business plus over INR250 crore from GScale, for a total of INR1,450 crore; FY28 and FY29 guidance to come later.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst asked whether the profit decline was due to inventory build-up and whether absolute PAT would rise QoQ from next quarter.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it was not inventory; lower interest income from deployed fixed deposits explains it. It confirmed absolute QoQ PAT should rise from the next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst asked whether the factory delay affects the INR250 crore target and whether any clients have signed.
qa_highlights.answer: GScale said go-live slipped about 15 days from end-November; SFN revenue targeted from 15 December. It cited more than 10 inquiries and pre-operational visits with a couple of unnamed customers, but no signed orders were named.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst asked about peak revenue and capacity utilisation timelines for the existing facility.
qa_highlights.answer: Management gave facility sq ft figures and said core capacity of about INR3,500-4,000 crore after the expansion, but gave no timeline and deferred guidance on peak revenue.

capex_capacity: Core SETL facility is about 8 lakh sq ft; management plans to add 3-4 lakh sq ft, to reach about 1.2 million sq ft, with an update expected in one to two months.
After the added 3-4 lakh sq ft, core production capacity is about INR3,500-4,000 crore (management figure). No timeline given; CEO said 'we will guide you on this growth prospect'.

GScale has about 4 lakh sq ft; 2.9 lakh sq ft to be operational from 15 January 2027, with another 1 lakh sq ft added in 3-4 months. A greenfield GScale facility of about 1.5-1.6 million sq ft on a 36-acre site is being built, taking GScale to 1.95 million sq ft in total.
GScale factory go-live slipped about 15 days from end-November to around 15 December 2026; most machinery is in place and a few components are yet to arrive for commissioning.
Management declined to give capex per MW or peak revenue from the current facility. Analyst cited INR500 crore data-center investment; CEO said the stake purchase is separate from that capex.
Analyst asked whether the company would go beyond 51% in GScale; management answered 'No'.
demand_pricing: Core order book stated at almost INR1,000 crore; order inflow about INR600 crore in H1 FY27, with a further INR600 crore targeted in H2 and about INR400-500 crore carrying into FY28.
CDMO and pharma demand described as strong with significant orders received, but no customer names or order values disclosed.

Exports about 7-8% of revenue in FY27; one large export order of USD 8-9 million said to be expected any time. Exports targeted at 20-30% of consolidated revenue in 2-3 years. Tie-ups: IPP for Europe and US, API Pharma for Middle East, Biocon Solutions for Southeast Asia (resellers).

GScale: more than 10 inquiries; pre-operational visits done with a couple of customers (unnamed). Recently qualified for a tender from one MNC; results pending. Management said a couple of MNCs are active and closure expected in the next couple of weeks.
GScale pricing: management said India is at least 25-30% cheaper than Southeast Asia for a switchgear panel delivered into the EMEA market.
GScale revenue mix for INR250 crore target: SFN pipes, installation and commissioning, and power products; management said the major portion comes from SFN.

adds.what: GScale Energy SFN and power products factory (2.9 lakh sq ft operational from 15 Jan 2027; 1 lakh sq ft more in 3-4 months), part of ~4 lakh sq ft GScale site
Greenfield GScale facility of 1.5-1.6 million sq ft on 36-acre site (total GScale 1.95 million sq ft)
Core SETL expansion adding 3-4 lakh sq ft to ~8 lakh sq ft facility (to ~12 lakh sq ft); core capacity ~INR3,500-4,000 crore after expansion

growth.why: FY27 consolidated revenue guided at INR1,450 crore (about 50% core growth plus over INR250 crore from GScale, which is pre-operational with go-live slipped to ~15 Dec 2026); backing is partly specific (order book ~INR1,000 crore, GScale factory timelines, core expansion of 3-4 lakh sq ft) but the core 50% growth and capacity timing for the core expansion lack numbers and timeline.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Core EBITDA margin is 17.3% and management expects it to reach about 20% over coming years, while GScale targets 20-25% long term, though GScale only starts contributing from Q3-Q4 FY27.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.when: Q3 FY27 (GScale SFN 15 Dec 2026, power products 15 Jan 2027)
rows.why: GScale 2.9 lakh sq ft operational from 15 Jan 2027 with 1 lakh sq ft more in 3-4 months, and greenfield 1.5-1.6 million sq ft facility under construction; go-live already slipped about 15 days, so timing is firm but at risk.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Core growth about 50% in FY27 with H1 order inflow about INR600 crore and a further INR600 crore targeted in H2 against an order book of almost INR1,000 crore; GScale adds over INR250 crore in Q4 FY27.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management said an update on the core 3-4 lakh sq ft expansion (to ~1.2 million sq ft) is expected in one to two months, and the core facility is already ~8 lakh sq ft with 50% core growth guided.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 total is held at INR1,450 crore with no raise signalled, and GScale orders are unnamed and unsigned.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: GScale's INR250 crore Q4 FY27 target depends on the 15 Dec go-live slipping no further, with no named or signed GScale orders disclosed and the MNC tender still pending.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: GScale power products production from 15 Jan 2027 and SFN revenue from 15 Dec 2026 are new offerings for a business with no operating history.

rows.label: Large USD 8-9 million export order
rows.why: Management said one large export order of USD 8-9 million is expected any time, but exports are only 7-8% of FY27 revenue and no customer is named.

rows.label: GScale MNC tender and hyperscaler closures
rows.why: Management said a couple of MNCs are active with closure expected in a couple of weeks and more than 10 inquiries are in hand, but the tender result is pending and described as slow to close.

rows.label: GScale stake to 51% via share swap
rows.why: Shareholders have approved the INR64 crore swap for a further 17.45%, pending stock exchange approval, taking the holding from 34% to 51%.

tone.note: Management was confident on the core order book (almost INR1,000 crore), CDMO demand and the data-centre opportunity, but evasive on named orders, peak revenue, capex per MW and FY28 guidance; analysts pushed on PAT decline, the GScale factory delay and whether clients had signed.
